title: ArtifactContentChart
description: Chart content payload for kind=chart. Supports static table-backed charts and Phase 1A live metric charts.

chartType.description: Optional semantic chart type hint, for example line, bar, pie, gauge, or heatmap.

dataRefs.description: References to source artifacts for static charts.

encodingHints.description: Optional human/UI hints such as axis labels, units, and legend fields.

spec.description: Renderer-specific spec. For Vega-Lite, this is a Vega-Lite JSON object.
